scenario_name: Mount Batur summit trail closure (volcanic alert raised)

trigger.reason: Indonesia's PVMBG (volcanology center) raises Mount Batur's alert status overnight after increased seismic tremors and gas emissions, closing the summit trail for the day as a precaution

original_plan_for_window.quality_note: Cancelled entirely by the closure — no partial option, since summit access is barred outright for safety

recovery_plans.label: Reorder: low-elevation sunrise walk and rice terraces instead
recovery_plans.description: Skip the volcano for today. Catch the early light on the Campuhan Ridge Walk, then visit Tegallalang Rice Terraces once it's fully light. Batur is rescheduled to a later morning of the trip if the alert level drops.
recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 875,000 rupiah and finishes about 4 hours earlier than the cancelled trek; trades the volcano summit for an easy ridge walk and rice terraces in similarly soft morning light.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who want an early-morning outing without the cost or effort of trekking an active volcano under alert

recovery_plans.label: Substitute: sleep in, Monkey Forest and Ubud Palace instead
recovery_plans.description: Drop the volcano trek entirely. Sleep in and do a relaxed late-morning visit to Ubud Monkey Forest and Ubud Palace, both a short walk from central Ubud.
recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 820,000 rupiah and nearly 5 hours; no pre-dawn wake-up needed. Batur is dropped from the itinerary altogether rather than rescheduled.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who'd rather sleep in and keep the day low-key than chase a volcano reschedule

recovery_plans.label: Pivot: clifftop sunset and Kecak fire dance at Uluwatu
recovery_plans.description: Swap the missed sunrise for a dramatic sunset instead. Head to Uluwatu Temple in the late afternoon for the clifftop views and the evening Kecak fire dance.

baseline_for_comparison.note: Compare against original window (900000) plus a casual evening out you'd likely have anyway (~150000 for a normal Ubud dinner)

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Costs 450,000 less than the cancelled sunrise trek plus a normal evening out would have; swaps the missed sunrise on an active volcano for a clifftop sunset and fire dance instead.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who want one spectacular golden-hour experience without an alpine-start wake-up
